limitations: The APK is read through an owned read-only snapshot; concurrent changes to the original cannot mix into this observation
Snapshot sections are located through the ELF dynamic symbol table; a payload without exported snapshot symbols is refused rather than guessed

Snapshot hash sources are the headers at the start of the VM and isolate data symbols; complete decoding supports kind 3 (the Dart 2.14 FullAOT layout), a valid hash and a declared length that fits its symbol, including the four magic bytes; other kind values remain observed with partial coverage
String-pool entries are byte-pattern observations from the isolate data section, not deserialized cluster semantics; typed class and function recovery needs an SDK-specific parser
class_like_tokens are identifier-shaped runs and include incidental matches

URI/token counts are lower bounds for runs matching pool_policy.contains: distinct collection stops at twice each selected projection bound. printable_run_count counts complete printable runs before filtering; overflowed runs are omitted, never fabricated as prefixes

String-pool admission reached pool_policy.token_limit=10. Retry with a narrower pool_policy.contains or increase token_limit (CLI --pool-policy JSON); no REA restart is required. Counts remain lower bounds and overflowed runs are omitted. APK, library and response limits are unchanged

String-pool admission reached pool_policy.run_bytes=1024. Retry with a narrower pool_policy.contains or increase run_bytes (CLI --pool-policy JSON); no REA restart is required. Counts remain lower bounds and overflowed runs are omitted. APK, library and response limits are unchanged

String-pool admission reached pool_policy.token_bytes=128. Retry with a narrower pool_policy.contains or increase token_bytes (CLI --pool-policy JSON); no REA restart is required. Counts remain lower bounds and overflowed runs are omitted. APK, library and response limits are unchanged
class_like_tokens reports 10 of at least 20 distinct tokens; narrow pool_policy.contains or raise pool_policy.token_limit (CLI --pool-policy JSON) on a new call, no restart required
